title: Ed4All intelligence_level_report.json
description: Top-level 0-5 course-intelligence self-assessment. Deterministic (no model): tallies PRESENT capability artifacts across five axes (key-terms glossary / concept graph / assessment density / prerequisite cross-links / FAQ). Built by lib/aggregators/intelligence_level.py::IntelligenceLevelAggregator post-workflow and emitted at <libv2_course>/intelligence_level_report.json. Gated by ED4ALL_INTELLIGENCE_RUBRIC (default OFF => no file). Worker W4.6.

course_code.description: Operator-facing course code so cross-run diffs key cleanly.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the build call.

score.description: Count of PRESENT axes (0-5). One point per capability artifact present.

max_score.description: Total addressable axes. 5 == Wave 4 W4.6 rubric size.

axes.description: Per-axis capability rows, in canonical axis order.

present.description: True when the capability artifact is present. FAQ is always absent (not built yet).

evidence.description: Per-axis deterministic evidence counters that drove the present/absent verdict (glossary edge counts, graph node/edge counts, assessment-item counts + density, prerequisite-edge counts, FAQ-absent note).
